output.reason: Sudden thunderclap headache described as the worst of her life one hour ago with new neck stiffness requires immediate emergency evaluation for subarachnoid hemorrhage, which cannot be excluded remotely.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. A headache that hits like a thunderclap and is the worst of your life, now with a stiff neck, can mean bleeding around the brain and needs emergency imaging right away. Do not drive yourself and do not wait for a reply here. If you become drowsy, confused, weak, or vomit while waiting, tell the dispatcher immediately.
differential: Meningitis or other secondary thunderclap cause (e.g. RCVS, dissection)

redFlags.concern: Thunderclap headache, worst of life, maximal at onset
redFlags.quote: worst headache of my life, totally out of nowhere while I was just sitting on the couch. It hit like a thunderclap
My neck feels a bit stiff now too
